**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

- **§ 7.6** is the only MFN-type provision in the agreement, and it runs *in our favour*: Brightline warrants that Fees charged to Northwind will be no less favourable than fees offered to similarly situated customers, qualified by a sensible comparability standard ("comparable volumes and terms").
- I checked the fee/pricing section (§ 7), order-form section (§ 4) and general provisions (§ 30), and ran searches for "favourable", "most favoured nation", third-party-terms and match-right language — no provision requires us to give Brightline terms no less favourable than those given to others, and no walk-away open-ended obligation exists.
- This satisfies the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so the clause is left untouched as a benefit to us.
